subject: Post-demo procurement intake — payment path & vendor packet for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.com>
To: Lindsay Harper <lindsay.harper@nimbushealth.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-06-18T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo procurement intake & payment path for Nimbus Health

Hi Lindsay — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can move procurement forward: 

- Ask 1: Which payment path does Nimbus prefer for onboarding? Options we typically see: PO (Net 30), corporate card, or marketplace (AWS/GCP/Azure).
- Ask 2: If PO, can you confirm billing contact and whether you require our W-9 (we can attach) and bank details for wiring?
- Ask 3: If you prefer a vendor portal, we can provide a vendor packet link or a DocuSign route.

I’ve attached our vendor packet that includes the standard paperwork (W-9, primary bank info page, and sample contract). If it’s easiest, I can send a DocuSign for signatures or share a one-time upload link to your vendor portal.

Attachments: Redwood_Vendor_Packet_v1.pdf (PDF, vendor packet incl. W-9 stub)

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm payment path + billing contact
2) We provide any missing docs (signed W-9, bank details) and the Redwoods vendor packet
3) Your procurement confirms the final onboarding path (PO vs card vs marketplace) and we schedule any follow-up call if needed

Ben — looping you in since you helped with the pricing configuration. If finance needs to be on the thread (banking/W-9 verification) I recommend adding Olga.

Thanks,
Rafael Mendes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Preferred payment path: PO (Net 30). We will issue a PO for the initial pilot.
- Billing contact: Morgan Lee (morgan.lee@nimbushealth.com), cc’d on this reply.
- Docs needed from Redwood: Fully executed W-9 (we need a PDF copy), company legal name for vendor record, and bank routing information for ACH.
- Vendor portal: we have a vendor portal (Coupa) but we can accept documents via DocuSign if easier.

I’ve attached our vendor onboarding form — please complete the sections highlighted in RED and return. Also let me know whether Redwood requires any reseller paperwork for marketplace billing (we’re primarily on AWS Marketplace currently).

Attachments: Nimbus_Vendor_Onboarding_Form_2026.pdf (PDF)

Thanks,

Hi Morgan / Rafael — thanks for including finance. Quick note from vendor-ops: once we receive the completed Nimbus onboarding form + the W-9 and either an ACH form or bank letter, our team will create the vendor record and confirm the tax/1099 classification. For a PO (Net 30) pilot there’s nothing blocking us beyond the docs — turn-around time on setup is typically 3–5 business days after receipt.

If you choose the marketplace route instead, please flag that now so we can prepare the reseller addendum; that can add an extra 5–7 business days for legal review.

If you prefer, Rafael can upload the PDFs to your Coupa portal and I’ll confirm receipt.
